intro: Trying to find Texas scholarships for high school students in the USA usually means sorting through programs that look similar at first glance but differ in who can apply, what they ask for, and how quickly deadlines arrive. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings tied to Texas, with categories that can include education, music, STEM, community, arts, and more. Some opportunities may fit current high school seniors most directly, while others connect to broader education paths or specific interests. Award amounts vary by listing, deadline timing is not the same across the rows, and requirement details can be lighter for some programs than others, so it is worth comparing each entry carefully before you apply.
